data.name: Sharveshi
data.gender_notes: Sharveshi is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Sharveshi is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Sharva', which refers to the Hindu god of love and fertility. The suffix '-eshi' adds a feminine touch to the name, making it a beautiful and meaningful name for a baby girl. The name Sharveshi carries the meaning “Goddess of Love” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Sharveshi usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of love and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Sharveshi is believed to bring love, joy, and creativity to the life of the person who bears it.
